scripts.build:audit: VITE_INCLUDE_AUDIT_SURFACE=true tsc -b && VITE_INCLUDE_AUDIT_SURFACE=true vite build --outDir dist-audit --sourcemap
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/core.spec.ts e2e/interactions.spec.ts e2e/authorization.spec.ts e2e/places.spec.ts e2e/budget.spec.ts e2e/recurrence.spec.ts e2e/calendar.spec.ts e2e/navigation.spec.ts e2e/tasks-notes.spec.ts e2e/albums.spec.ts e2e/shell.spec.ts e2e/assistant.spec.ts e2e/management.spec.ts
scripts.test:real: VITE_GATEWAY=http npm run build:http && VITE_GATEWAY=http playwright test --config playwright.real.config.ts
scripts.audit:a11y: npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/accessibility.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.audit:visual: npm run build:audit && PLAYWRIGHT_AUDIT=true playwright test e2e/capture.spec.ts --project=chromium && node scripts/build-gallery.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run build:http && npm run build:server && npm run audit:security && npm run audit:ui && npm run audit:controls && npm run audit:contract && npm run audit:routes && npm run audit:use-cases && npm run audit:lighthouse && npm run test:e2e && npm run audit:a11y && npm run test:real
scripts.package: npm run verify && npm run render:er && npm run audit:visual && bash scripts/package.sh
